crossRefs.note: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you…
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my…
But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self…
By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.
You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

translations.web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
